import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class TreeNode {
        int key;
        int value;
        TreeNode left;
        TreeNode right;
        TreeNode parent;
        int height;
        int num_left;
        int num_total;

        public TreeNode(int k, int v) {
            this.key = k;
            this.value = v;
            this.left = null;
            this.right = null;
            this.parent = null;
            this.height = 1;
            this.num_left = 1;
            this.num_total = 1;
        }
    }

    static class AvlTree {
        TreeNode _tree;

        public void add(int k, int v) {
            if (_tree == null) {
                _tree = new TreeNode(k, v);
                return;
            }
            TreeNode node = _add(k, v);
            if (node != null) {
                _rebalance(node);
            }
        }

        TreeNode _add(int k, int v) {
            TreeNode node = _tree;
            while (node != null) {
                if (k < node.key) {
                    if (node.left != null) {
                        node = node.left;
                    } else {
                        node.left = new TreeNode(k, v);
                        node.left.parent = node;
                        return node.left;
                    }
                } else if (node.key < k) {
                    if (node.right != null) {
                        node = node.right;
                    } else {
                        node.right = new TreeNode(k, v);
                        node.right.parent = node;
                        return node.right;
                    }
                } else {
                    node.value = v;
                    return null;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        static int get_height(TreeNode x) {
            return x == null ? 0 : x.height;
        }

        static int get_num_total(TreeNode x) {
            return x == null ? 0 : x.num_total;
        }

        void _rebalance(TreeNode node) {
            TreeNode n = node;
            while (n != null) {
                int lh = get_height(n.left);
                int rh = get_height(n.right);
                n.height = Math.max(lh, rh) + 1;
                int balance_factor = lh - rh;
                n.num_total = 1 + get_num_total(n.left) + get_num_total(n.right);
                n.num_left = 1 + get_num_total(n.left);

                if (balance_factor > 1) {
                    if (get_height(n.left.left) < get_height(n.left.right)) {
                        _rotate_left(n.left);
                    }
                    _rotate_right(n);
                } else if (balance_factor < -1) {
                    if (get_height(n.right.right) < get_height(n.right.left)) {
                        _rotate_right(n.right);
                    }
                    _rotate_left(n);
                } else {
                    n = n.parent;
                }
            }
        }

        void _remove_one(TreeNode node) {
            TreeNode replacement = node.left == null ? node.right : node.left;
            if (node.parent != null) {
                if (AvlTree._is_left(node)) {
                    node.parent.left = replacement;
                } else {
                    node.parent.right = replacement;
                }
                replacement.parent = node.parent;
                node.parent = null;
            } else {
                _tree = replacement;
                replacement.parent = null;
            }
            node.left = null;
            node.right = null;
            node.parent = null;
            _rebalance(replacement);
        }

        void _remove_leaf(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.parent != null) {
                if (AvlTree._is_left(node)) {
                    node.parent.left = null;
                } else {
                    node.parent.right = null;
                }
                _rebalance(node.parent);
            } else {
                _tree = null;
            }
            node.parent = null;
            node.left = null;
            node.right = null;
        }

        int get(int k) {
            TreeNode node = _get_node(k);
            return node == null ? -1 : node.value;
        }

        TreeNode _get_node(int k) {
            if (_tree == null) {
                return null;
            }
            TreeNode node = _tree;
            while (node != null) {
                if (k < node.key) {
                    node = node.left;
                } else if (node.key < k) {
                    node = node.right;
                } else {
                    return node;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        String[] get_at(int pos) {
            int x = pos + 1;
            TreeNode node = _tree;
            while (node != null) {
                if (x < node.num_left) {
                    node = node.left;
                } else if (node.num_left < x) {
                    x -= node.num_left;
                    node = node.right;
                } else {
                    return new String[]{Integer.toString(node.key), Integer.toString(node.value)};
                }
            }
            return new String[]{"Out of ranges"};
        }

        static boolean _is_left(TreeNode node) {
            return node.parent != null && node.parent.left == node;
        }

        static boolean _is_leaf(TreeNode node) {
            return node.left == null && node.right == null;
        }

        void _rotate_right(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.parent == null) {
                _tree = node.left;
                node.left.parent = null;
            } else if (AvlTree._is_left(node)) {
                node.parent.left = node.left;
                node.left.parent = node.parent;
            } else {
                node.parent.right = node.left;
                node.left.parent = node.parent;
            }
            node.left.right = node;
            node.parent = node.left;
            node.left = node.left.right;
            if (node.left != null) {
                node.left.parent = node;
            }
            node.height = Math.max(get_height(node.left), get_height(node.right)) + 1;
            node.num_total = 1 + get_num_total(node.left) + get_num_total(node.right);
            node.num_left = 1 + get_num_total(node.left);
        }

        void _rotate_left(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.parent == null) {
                _tree = node.right;
                node.right.parent = null;
            } else if (AvlTree._is_left(node)) {
                node.parent.left = node.right;
                node.right.parent = node.parent;
            } else {
                node.parent.right = node.right;
                node.right.parent = node.parent;
            }
            node.right.left = node;
            node.parent = node.right;
            node.right = node.right.left;
            if (node.right != null) {
                node.right.parent = node;
            }
            node.height = Math.max(get_height(node.left), get_height(node.right)) + 1;
            node.num_total = 1 + get_num_total(node.left) + get_num_total(node.right);
            node.num_left = 1 + get_num_total(node.left);
        }

        TreeNode _get_next(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.right == null) {
                return node.parent;
            }
            TreeNode n = node.right;
            while (n.left != null) {
                n = n.left;
            }
            return n;
        }
    }

    static class SegmentTree {
        int[] data;
        int default_val;
        int func(int a, int b) {
            return Math.min(a, b);
        }

        public SegmentTree(int[] data, int default_val, int func) {
            this.default_val = default_val;
            this.func = func;
            this.data = new int[2 * data.length];
            System.arraycopy(data, 0, this.data, this.data.length / 2, data.length);
            for (int i = this.data.length / 2 - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                this.data[i] = func(this.data[2 * i + 1], this.data[2 * i + 2]);
            }
        }

        int query(int start, int stop) {
            if (start == stop) {
                return data[start + data.length / 2];
            }
            stop++;
            start += data.length / 2;
            stop += data.length / 2;
            int res = default_val;
            while (start < stop) {
                if (start % 2 == 1) {
                    res = func(res, data[start]);
                    start++;
                }
                if (stop % 2 == 1) {
                    stop--;
                    res = func(res, data[stop]);
                }
                start >>= 1;
                stop >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static class Combination {
        int MOD;
        Factorial factorial;

        public Combination(int MOD) {
            this.MOD = MOD;
            this.factorial = new Factorial(MOD);
        }

        int ncr(int n, int k) {
            if (k < 0 || n < k) {
                return 0;
            }
            k = Math.min(k, n - k);
            return factorial.calc(n) * factorial.invFactorial(Math.max(n - k, k)) * factorial.invFactorial(Math.min(k, n - k)) % MOD;
        }
    }

    static class Factorial {
        int MOD;
        int[] factorials;
        int[] invModulos;
        int[] invFactorials;

        public Factorial(int MOD) {
            this.MOD = MOD;
            this.factorials = new int[MOD + 1];
            this.invModulos = new int[MOD + 1];
            this.invFactorials = new int[MOD + 1];
            factorials[1] = factorials[0] = 1;
            invModulos[0] = invModulos[1] = 1;
            invFactorials[1] = invFactorials[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i <= MOD; i++) {
                factorials[i] = (int) ((long) factorials[i - 1] * i % MOD);
                invModulos[i] = (int) ((long) invModulos[MOD % i] * (MOD - MOD / i) % MOD);
                invFactorials[i] = (int) ((long) invFactorials[i - 1] * invModulos[i] % MOD);
            }
        }

        long calc(int n) {
            if (n <= -1) {
                System.out.println("Invalid argument to calculate n!");
                System.out.println("n must be non-negative value. But the argument was " + n);
                System.exit(0);
            }
            if (n < factorials.length) {
                return factorials[n];
            }
            int[] next = new int[n + 1 - factorials.length];
            int initialI = factorials.length;
            long prev = factorials[initialI - 1];
            int m = MOD;
            for (int i = initialI; i <= n; i++) {
                prev = (prev * i) % m;
                next[i - initialI] = (int) prev;
            }
            System.arraycopy(next, 0, factorials, initialI, next.length);
            return factorials[n];
        }

        long inv(int n) {
            if (n <= -1) {
                System.out.println("Invalid argument to calculate n^(-1)");
                System.out.println("n must be non-negative value. But the argument was " + n);
                System.exit(0);
            }
            int p = MOD;
            int pi = n % p;
            if (pi < invModulos.length) {
                return invModulos[pi];
            }
            int[] next = new int[n + 1 - invModulos.length];
            int initialI = invModulos.length;
            for (int i = initialI; i < Math.min(p, n + 1); i++) {
                int next_val = (int) (-invModulos[p % i] * (p / i) % p);
                invModulos[i] = next_val;
                next[i - initialI] = next_val;
            }
            return invModulos[pi];
        }

        long invFactorial(int n) {
            if (n <= -1) {
                System.out.println("Invalid argument to calculate (n^(-1))!");
                System.out.println("n must be non-negative value. But the argument was " + n);
                System.exit(0);
            }
            if (n < invFactorials.length) {
                return invFactorials[n];
            }
            inv(n); // To make sure already calculated n^-1
            int[] next = new int[n + 1 - invFactorials.length];
            int initialI = invFactorials.length;
            long prev = invFactorials[initialI - 1];
            int p = MOD;
            for (int i = initialI; i <= n; i++) {
                prev = (prev * invModulos[i % p]) % p;
                next[i - initialI] = (int) prev;
            }
            System.arraycopy(next, 0, invFactorials, initialI, next.length);
            return invFactorials[n];
        }
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public FastScanner() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner();
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] l = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            l[i] = scanner.nextInt() % k;
        }
        Set<Integer> s = new TreeSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            s.add(l[i]);
            for (int j : s) {
                s.add((j + l[i]) % k);
            }
        }
        s = new TreeSet<>(s);
        s.add(l[n / 2]);
        for (int i = n / 2; i < n; i++) {
            s.add(l[i]);
            for (int j : s) {
                s.add((j + l[i]) % k);
            }
        }
        s = new TreeSet<>(s);
        int ans = (int) Math.max(s.toArray()[s.size() / 2], k - 1 - s.toArray()[s.size() / 2]);
        for (int i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
            int t = k - 1 - s.toArray()[i];
            int ind = binarySearch(s.toArray(), 0, s.size() - 1, t);
            int r = s.toArray()[ind - 1];
            int rt = s.toArray()[s.size() - 1];
            t = ans;
            ans = Math.max((r + s.toArray()[i]) % k, (s.toArray()[i] + rt) % k);
            ans = Math.max(ans, t);
        }
        out.println(ans);
        out.close();
    }

    static int binarySearch(int[] arr, int start, int end, int key) {
        while (start <= end) {
            int mid = (start + end) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] <= key) {
                start = mid + 1;
            } else {
                end = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        return start;
    }
